items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I just got the impression that... he had Stacy and he had Wilson. And I guess if he’d had his druthers he probably would have had Wilson on piano for the whole thing. But I’m just talking. I don’t really know for sure.

ctx.x: Well a question — I don’t know if I would have had it back then — but I’ve never really been clear about Benny Goodman’s role with this integration thing and how that happened. And you had said something to me yesterday about it. And Helen Dance had talked about her role in that. But what’s your take on exactly how it happened.

Well my take on it is sort of what I’ve gotten from reading various books and articles. So I mean I wasn’t there so I can’t say I have any firsthand knowledge, but I just got the impression that, you know, he wanted these two musicians in his organization. He wanted Wilson and he wanted Hampton. But he was smart enough to know that if he put them in the full big band it was going to cause problems. Not that they weren’t going to cause problems anyway having them as a sideshow, but I think it caused less problems…
Well there sure are a lot of Benny Goodman stories.
